text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...I couldn't do it. I couldn't win. Yet
again...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I failed to meet everyone's expectations.
My
father, my mother, the whole Satono
family... and
even yours.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Let's start again from square one. If all of
my
effort thus far has fallen short, it only
means I
have to work even harder.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's okay! I'll get through any training
necessary in
order to win next time!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
choice_data_list_en: Then let's take a deep breath first.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: In... and out... Innnnn... and out...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
choice_data_list: 無理せず、前に進んでいこう
choice_data_list_en: Without pushing ourselves too hard, let's keep moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Nothing is going to keep me down! Let's
keep
going together!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But if we're going broke, I guess I better
get my
wallet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Going for broke" is just a saying but,
either way,
she seems to have cheered
up a bit. We're both
going to get back
up and keep working.
